config.title: Ice Skating in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: When each Berlin ice rink opens, what it costs, and which ones run in any weather.

items.q: When does the ice skating season start in Berlin?
items.a: It starts rink by rink. The **Sportforum Hohenschönhausen** hall plans to open on **12 October 2026** (provisional), **Winterquartier** at Ostkreuz on **6 November**, and Horst-Dohm and Lankwitz are expected in November. Neukölln and Erika-Heß had no 2026/27 date on 8 October.

items.q: How much does ice skating cost in Berlin?
items.a: At the Sportforum, Horst-Dohm and Neukölln adults pay **4 euros, 2 euros reduced**. Erika-Heß and Lankwitz charge **7 euros**, and Winterquartier **6 to 9.50 euros** by slot. Skate hire is extra, for example **7 euros** at the Sportforum.

items.q: Which Berlin ice rinks are indoors?
items.a: The **Sportforum** speed-skating hall in Hohenschönhausen, **Winterquartier** at Ostkreuz and the hall at **Erika-Heß-Eisstadion** in Wedding. They run in rain and mild weather, when outdoor rinks may close.

items.q: Do I need to book ice skating tickets online?
items.a: At **Winterquartier** you book 90-minute slots online. The **Sportforum** sells Friday to Sunday, Monday evening and school-holiday tickets **only online**. The other rinks sell at the gate.

items.q: Where can I skate long distances in Berlin?
items.a: At **Horst-Dohm-Eisstadion** in Wilmersdorf, whose outer ring is a **400-metre speed-skating oval**. It is expected to run from November to early March.

items.q: Is it safe to skate on frozen lakes in Berlin?
items.a: Nobody confirms it. The Berlin water police **never release an ice surface**, and the districts and the Senate do not either, so anyone on a frozen lake or canal is there **at their own risk**. Stay on a rink.
